Nothing for a guest to install

The RSVP is part of the invitation page. A guest opens the link, answers, and is done — usually inside a minute.

Ask real questions

Attendance, how many are coming, a meal preference and a message. Enough to plan from, short enough that people finish it.

Replies reach you directly

A reply is composed and sent straight to the contact details you put on the invitation, so it lands where you already look.
